predefined_info.altitude: Elevation (m) from the [NASA SRTM 30 m](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/USGS_SRTMGL1_003) digital elevation model, clipped to your AOI. Continuous.
predefined_info.slope: Terrain slope (degrees) computed from the [NASA SRTM 30 m](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/USGS_SRTMGL1_003) elevation with Earth Engine's `ee.Terrain.slope`. Continuous.
predefined_info.protected_area: Binary mask (1 = inside a protected area) built by rasterizing the designated/inscribed/established/proposed polygons of the [WDPA — World Database on Protected Areas](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/WCMC_WDPA_current_polygons).
predefined_info.rivers: Binary mask of water from the [OSM Water Layer](https://gee-community-catalog.org/projects/osm_water/), clipped to your AOI. By default large lakes and rivers, major rivers, canals and small streams count as water (ocean excluded); change the classes under Advanced parameters.
predefined_info.roads: Binary mask of roads rasterized from [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/) road geometries, clipped to your AOI.
predefined_info.forest_gfc: Forest/non-forest mask (1 = forest) for the chosen year, derived from [Hansen Global Forest Change](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/UMD_hansen_global_forest_change_2025_v1_13): pixels above the tree-cover threshold in 2000 minus loss up to that year. Temporal.
predefined_info.forest_tmf: Forest/non-forest mask (1 = forest) at 1 January of the chosen year from the [JRC Tropical Moist Forest](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/projects_JRC_TMF_v1_2024_AnnualChanges) annual-change product. By default only undisturbed forest counts; Advanced parameters can add degraded forest and regrowth. Temporal.
predefined_info.towns: Binary urban-area mask (1 = built-up + populated) for the nearest epoch, from [JRC GHSL](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/JRC_GHSL_P2023A_GHS_BUILT_S) population and built-surface layers. Temporal (5-year epochs).
predefined_info.subj: Categorical raster of level-2 administrative subjurisdictions from [FAO GAUL](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/FAO_GAUL_2015_level2), each zone given a distinct value. Used for JNR-style stratification.
predefined_info.precipitation: Total annual precipitation (mm/year) for the chosen year, summing the 12 monthly totals of [ERA5-Land Monthly Aggregates](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/ECMWF_ERA5_LAND_MONTHLY_AGGR) (~11 km). Continuous. Temporal.
predefined_info.temperature_2m: Air temperature at 2 m (°C) for the chosen year, combining the 12 monthly means of [ERA5-Land Monthly Aggregates](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/ECMWF_ERA5_LAND_MONTHLY_AGGR) with the chosen aggregation metric (~11 km). Continuous. Temporal.

modal.source_hint: Predefined = ready-made Earth Engine layers; User = your own raster, vector or GEE asset.
modal.param_tree_cover_threshold_hint: Minimum canopy cover in 2000 counted as forest (1-100). It becomes part of the variable name, so several thresholds can coexist.
modal.param_aggregation_hint: How the 12 monthly values are combined into the yearly value. It becomes part of the variable name, so several metrics can coexist.
modal.custom_type_hint: Local raster file = GeoTIFF on disk; Google Earth Engine asset = GEE asset; Local vector file = vector file, rasterized during harmonization.
modal.custom_year_hint: Set for temporal layers so the same variable can be added per year; leave blank for static ones.
modal.custom_scale_hint: Nominal pixel size in metres used when exporting this GEE asset.
modal.band_hint: This raster has {count} bands; the layer uses only the one picked here.
modal.custom_raster_type_hint: continuous = measured values (e.g. elevation); categorical = classes or 0/1 masks.
modal.stretch_hint: Reads the layer's percentiles (an Earth Engine asset over the AOI) and fills Min and Max. Leave both empty to stretch automatically.
modal.find_classes: Find the classes in the layer
modal.find_classes_hint: Lists the values found in a sample of the layer (an Earth Engine asset over the AOI). A rare value can be missed: add it by hand. Values not listed are transparent.
modal.find_features_hint: Lists one class per feature, in file order, named from the file's first text column; features not listed are transparent.
modal.err_too_many_features: More than 50 features: the layer is drawn with automatic colours.
modal.zero_one_note: Only 0 and 1 were found: 0 starts hidden (transparent). Click its eye to draw it.
modal.err_class_value: Enter a whole number not already listed.
modal.err_no_classes: Find the classes or add a value.
modal.err_duplicate_class: Each value can be listed once.
modal.err_class_limit: A categorical layer holds at most 50 classes.
modal.err_range: Min and Max must be numbers, Min below Max, or both empty.
modal.err_not_integer: This layer has non-integer values: set its raster type to continuous.
modal.err_too_many_classes: More than 50 values: this layer looks continuous.
modal.err_no_stretch: The layer has no spread of values.
modal.probe_failed: Could not read the layer's values: {error}
modal.custom_rasterization_method_hint: binary = 1 where a feature is present, 0 elsewhere; unique = one value per feature/class.
modal.error_no_predefined_selected: Select a variable from the list.
modal.error_year_required: Year is required for this variable.
modal.error_param_range: {label} must be a whole number between {min} and {max}.
modal.param_water_classes_hint: OSM Water Layer classes mapped as water (1). A non-default selection adds a code to the variable name (e.g. rivers_wlmc).
modal.param_tmf_definition_hint: TMF classes counted as forest. A non-default choice is added to the variable name (e.g. forest_tmf_degraded).
modal.error_param_multichoice: Select at least one option for {label}.
